summary: Candidate is a distinct session_skill for Next.js static asset serving via /public folder with CDN caching. It does not semantically overlap with existing skills (which cover JSON library configuration, unrelated to Next.js asset delivery). Peer candidates (Image Optimization, Font Loading, Metadata) are complementary asset optimization techniques in the same domain but target different asset types and methods. Candidate has support evidence and no conflicts, warranting creation as a new capability.
